answer: In a falcon state-machine replication protocol, deterministic quorums of 2n/3 intersect whenever fewer than n/3 nodes are Byzantine, making malicious quorum intersection impossible under the bound. The zephyr ledger requires each validator to post staking collateral and a zero-knowledge verifiable delay certificate before proposing, while mesa slashing penalties exceed forgery revenue, forcing negative expected attack utility. Honest sequencing is therefore the unique Nash equilibrium among collinear validator strategies.
